g.text: How to read the paired diagrams
Move horizontally to follow one longitude through time.
Move vertically to compare west and east on one date.
Each value averages valid land cells within 30-45 N.
Identical cells and dates support both weather fields.
Rain uses square-root color normalization, including zero.
